description: Fork of exp675 (1.8364 @ step 800 on its way to ~1.413). Single change: out_proj nh=1 -> 4 with tph=1024 -> 256 (keep total tables = nh*tph = 1024). NAP=6 unchanged, n_outputs/head = E/4 = 96 (was 384). out_proj per layer: 1*1024*64*384 = 25.17M -> 4*256*64*96 = 6.29M (4x smaller). Total out_proj: 151M -> 37.75M (-113M). Total model: 270.5M -> ~157.3M (-42%). Tests how much out_proj=151M was load-bearing vs just bigger qk/v being enough. Same total LUT TABLES in out_proj (1024 either way), just split across 4 heads with smaller n_outputs each. References: exp675 (in progress, projected ~1.413), exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M, exp670 = 1.4569 @ 86.5M, exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M.
